steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) p:loadSummonInfo({},function(code) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-summon-info-'..tostring(code)) end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('summon',{}) end)
